note: Human adjudication of the August 2026 candidate intake against the live 721-card bank. Similarity is recorded as evidence, never as the decision: the matcher ranked the correct parametric-rolling card THIRD (AUG-0012) behind an unrelated tonnage card, and ranked an unrelated DP card first for AUG-0001. Every GENUINE_NEW_QUESTION row states the negative search that established the gap, so the judgement can be rechecked rather than the arithmetic.
governing_principle: A new card is created only when the examiner's actual tested ask is materially distinct from every live card. Novel wording alone is never sufficient.

vocabularies.cross_batch_note: SAME_AS_BATCH1_NEW and EXPANDS_BATCH1_NEW were added for batch 2. existing_card_defects.defect: The 15-Second Answer practice-block is present but empty: a pb-label span with no body after it. A candidate opening this card sees a labelled block and no answer.
existing_card_defects.scope: Not isolated. A sweep of every QB page found 18 empty practice-blocks, and all 18 are the 15-Second Answer of every question in QB5_C_A.html (q1-q10) and QB5_C_B.html (q1-q8). The two files were authored without that block. This predates the August intake and is unrelated to it.
existing_card_defects.action: A single-card repair to QB5_C_A#q4 was authored during this session and then deliberately REVERTED, because a batch manifest cannot own a post-release repair and because fixing 1 of 18 identical defects would leave QB5_C_A internally inconsistent. The whole 18-card class is registered as OPEN-G1-001 in AUGUST2026_OPEN_ITEMS.json for a properly sized correction run.
